payload.detail: PARTLY FIXED 2026-09-25 in eb55cf1a2: (a) use-universal-search.ts now reports a query over 200 characters as a distinct too-long state (no fetch), and a non-OK or network failure as an error that is never cached; aborted requests stay silent. The command surface shows a one-line notice for each (pinned by tests/use-universal-search-stream.dom.test.tsx and tests/universal-search-command-notice.dom.test.tsx). The API route is unchanged. The single-character half was dropped earlier (the client never sends a query under 2 characters). STILL OPEN: (b) the Serum creatinine NumberField rejects 1.02 with 'Enter 15-3000.' - the only numeric field whose range message carries no unit (CrCl says mL/min, QTc says ms). 1.02 is an ordinary mg/dL value and the bound shown is the umol/L one.
